title: Windows virtual desktop switch flash/overlay disappeared after enabling PowerToys Snap and/or Workspaces

judgment.rationale: The report provides the feature toggle, exact virtual-desktop keyboard shortcut, before/after behavior, Windows build, and PowerToys version. It is specific enough for maintainer-side reproduction without a generic request for diagnostics; the responsible integration remains unknown.
evidence: PowerToys 0.96.1 and Windows 11 Pro build 26100 are stated.
The native desktop-switch overlay appeared before enabling Snap Pages / Layout Design, but not afterward when switching with Ctrl+Win+Right/Left.
Disabling Override Windows Snap did not restore the overlay; no other reporter follow-up exists.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the desktop-switch overlay behavior with FancyZones on the reported OS/build before choosing a fix design.

fix_assessment.rationale: The visible symptom has a maintainer-ready repro, but the report alone does not identify whether FancyZones, another PowerToys module, or Windows controls the missing shell overlay; a code fix cannot yet be scoped.

issue_context.summary: The Windows virtual-desktop switch overlay reportedly stops appearing after enabling PowerToys Snap/Layout Design, even with Override Windows Snap disabled.
known_information: The report names Windows 11 Pro build 26100 and PowerToys 0.96.1.
The trigger is Ctrl+Win+Right/Left after enabling Snap Pages / Layout Design.
The same Windows overlay appeared before the feature was enabled.
Disabling Override Windows Snap did not bring it back.
inferences: The setting transition correlates with the symptom; the report does not prove which hook or Windows component suppresses the overlay.
issue_context.analysis: The existing before/after comparison and keyboard sequence support a focused local repro. Observe the Windows shell overlay with PowerToys off and FancyZones on, then isolate the specific feature before proposing code changes.
initial_investigation: Read the live body and automated triage comment; no additional evidence, linked fix, or reporter response changes the concrete repro.

prerequisites: Windows 11 Pro build 26100 or a matching Windows 11 build
Create at least two Windows virtual desktops
steps: With PowerToys disabled, switch between desktops using Ctrl+Win+Right/Left and note whether the native Windows desktop-switch overlay appears.
Enable PowerToys and FancyZones Snap Pages / Layout Design, then use the same shortcut and observe the overlay.
Disable Override Windows Snap and repeat; if the overlay remains absent, disable FancyZones and repeat to isolate the setting.
reproduce.expected: The native Windows overlay remains visible when switching virtual desktops.
